text:
alex: Quick sync: customer pilots demanding stronger evidence & per-tenant retention controls. We need a crisp GA checklist.

maria: Agreed. Propose GA must-haves: 1) BYOK/CMEK handshake with clear rotation semantics, 2) exportable audit bundle (signed), 3) retention API + UI toggles, 4) legal-hold flag that suspends TTLs.

lee: Infra constraints: making everything searchable is expensive. For GA, default to metadata indexing and cold-store raw events. Add a customer opt-in for full indexing.

nina: Compliance note: SOC2/ISO want proof of integrity. Exports must include a signed manifest and hash chain for verification. Also need an auditable who/when/why for legal hold actions.

maria: UX suggestion: retention presets (30/90/365) + custom days for enterprise. Legal hold should show analyst + ticket reference.

alex: Ops requirements: runbook for evidence requests, export SLA (recommend 95% < 3h for <=30d), and an emergency preserve workflow for legal teams.

lee: Technical sketch: store events as append-only objects with monotonic sequence + periodic signed checkpoints (proofs) written to immutable store. Keep index_mode toggle per-tenant.

nina: Also capture threat model briefly in spec: attacker goals (delete/roll-back logs, swap manifests), detection windows, and key rotation authority. That drives proof frequency.

maria: For roadmap prioritization: Phase 1 (GA): BYOK handshake, signed export bundle, retention API/UI, legal-hold suspend, minimal provenance metadata. Phase 2: customer search SLA, full indexing opt-in, cross-region replay.

alex: I'll create the PROD ticket and ask infra + security for sizing. If we agree on GA list now, we can schedule the sprint.

ops-bot: Created ticket #PROD-8809 "Retention & evidence GA checklist" and assigned to @alex, @lee, @maria.

security-bot: Reminder: run external key attestation checklist before GA.

alex: Thanks. I'll post this into the roadmap doc and follow up with a short spec draft tomorrow.
